summary_hint: HOA certification for Maple Court Condominium, Unit 4B — 120 units, 68% owner-occupied, dues $385/mo, 4% delinquent, no pending litigation.

typed_core.name: unit_address_or_number
typed_core.why: identity — which unit the subject loan is on

typed_core.name: developer_control_status
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Developer/declarant in control' vs 'turned over to owners' is the control-status signal; a turnover date implies owner control

typed_core.name: owner_occupied_units
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish owner-occupied, second-home, and investor as three separate buckets — collapsing them inverts the occupancy ratio

typed_core.name: dues_frequency
typed_core.why: disambiguator — monthly vs quarterly vs annual; the dues figure is unreadable without it

typed_core.name: delinquent_units_percentage
typed_core.why: processor — >15% delinquency is a warrantability fail

typed_core.name: master_insurance_carrier
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture carrier alongside amount so an unlabeled figure can be judged

typed_core.name: master_insurance_amount
typed_core.why: processor — coverage amount vs replacement cost

nested_lists.name: special_assessments
nested_lists.shape_reason: a certification lists 0–5 assessments; flat rows are light and support an assessment-review check. Serves future warrantability

fields.name: description
fields.why: the assessment description for an assessment-review check

fields.name: amount
fields.why: amount a processor sums across assessments

rejected.name: issuer_name, issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: association_management_company / association_contact_phone carry the source and contact

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: not the relevant parties on a project cert

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block, signature_or_certification
rejected.reason: completed_by_name_title carries attribution; execution not rule-checked

rejected.name: reserve_balance_and_contribution, reserve_study_date_and_findings
rejected.reason: reserve detail; annual_budget is the processor proxy; leave detail to catch-all until a reserve rule lands

rejected.name: structural_or_deferred_maintenance, building_safety_or_inspection_status
rejected.reason: second/third nested lists; over budget — catch-all

encoding_variations: regular_hoa_dues / dues_frequency — '$385/mo', '$1,155/quarter', '$4,620 annually'; always carry the frequency
delinquent_units — stated as a count, a percentage, or both, and the delinquency threshold (30 vs 60 days) varies; capture the stated count and % verbatim, and note the aging basis if given
owner_occupied vs investor — sometimes a count, sometimes a percentage; second-home units are a third bucket that must not be folded into either
master_insurance — carrier + dwelling/replacement amount stated together or on an attached ACORD; capture carrier alongside amount so an unlabeled figure can be judged

open_questions.q: Which one nested list? special_assessments vs pending_litigation — both are CORE-adjacent object[] warrantability signals
open_questions.recommendation: nest special_assessments (amounts a processor sums) and carry pending-litigation as a flat presence flag; revisit if a litigation rule needs case-level detail

open_questions.q: delinquent_units flattening — flattened to delinquent_units_percentage. If a rule needs both count and denominator separately, split into delinquent_units_count + _percentage
open_questions.recommendation: keep flattened until a rule needs the count and denominator separately

open_questions.q: master_insurance flattening — flattened to carrier + amount. If a rule needs deductible / replacement-cost basis (the IH-1 pattern), add those two fields rather than the whole object
open_questions.recommendation: keep carrier + amount; add the two fields only if an IH-1-pattern rule needs them

notes: No rules consume this type today, so there is no rule floor. This is effectively a project-warrantability worksheet; even absent rules, the fields chosen are the ones a condo/PUD warrantability rule will need (occupancy ratio, delinquency, single-entity concentration, insurance, litigation) plus identity and dues.
pending_litigation is NOT nested (one-list budget) — its presence/absence is the load-bearing signal; capture the summary in the catch-all.
No borrower PII. completed_by_name_title and association_contact_phone are business-contact, standard sensitivity. Nothing needs _PII_FIELDS.

Prompt hint (doc-level): Fannie Mae condo warrantability thresholds the fields feed: <=15% delinquency, single-entity concentration limits, <=35% commercial space, adequate reserves (>=10% budget), fidelity/crime coverage for >20 units — capture the stated numbers, do not evaluate them.
Ambiguity: regular_hoa_dues is tagged 'headline' in the markdown, which is not a defined reason_class; classified as processor (the DTI/housing-expense figure a processor wants).
